task.title: Let the desktop style checker accept data-driven class prefixes
task.description: desktop/scripts/check-styles.js harvests class names from template literals in the renderer and requires a rule for each. A modifier built from data (`next-row__priority--${task.priority}`) harvests as the fragment next-row__priority-- and fails the check, so the Next view had to hard-code the one modifier it styles. Teach the checker that a harvested name ending in -- is a prefix, satisfied by any rule whose selector starts with it, so chips can be data-driven and still checked. Found while building the Next view.
